title: A constructive solution to Talagrand's Gaussian convexification problem
summary: Talagrand asked for a construction of a large convex subset of a bounded Minkowski sum of a large Gaussian set. We first prove a stronger nonsymmetric existential statement: if $A\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ is measurable and $γ_n(A)>2/3$, then $A+A+A$ contains a compact convex set of Gaussian measure at least $1/2$.
